boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named USF spaces with documented uses for study, connection, recreation, and campus life.

cards.title: Gleeson Library Atrium
cards.subtitle: Gleeson Library | Geschke Center
cards.notes: Bring a solo task and use the atrium as a quiet study option; USF’s campus resource guide specifically identifies it among quiet places.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study area inside Gleeson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the Gleeson Library Atrium.
cards.access_notes: Library access may require a valid USF ID, according to USF’s academic-services guidance.

cards.title: Gleeson Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Gleeson Library | Geschke Center
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor when you need a designated quiet-place option, then follow posted library guidance for respectful shared study.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor quiet-study location in Gleeson.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the fourth floor of Gleeson Library.
cards.access_notes: Library access may require a valid USF ID, according to USF’s academic-services guidance.

cards.title: Lo Schiavo Basement Lounge
cards.subtitle: John Lo Schiavo, S.J. Center for Science and Innovation
cards.notes: Use this named basement lounge as a change-of-scene study stop, especially when you want an indoor shared space away from the library.
cards.short_summary: A campus quiet-place lounge in the science center.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the Lo Schiavo Basement Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Located in the John Lo Schiavo, S.J. Center for Science and Innovation; check building access conditions onsite.

cards.title: Kalmanovitz Atrium
cards.subtitle: Kalmanovitz Hall
cards.notes: Set up for a brief reading or planning session in this named atrium, listed by USF as one of its quiet places on campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-place atrium in Kalmanovitz Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the Kalmanovitz Atrium.
cards.access_notes: Kalmanovitz Hall is listed on USF’s campus map; check building access conditions onsite.

cards.title: Kalmanovitz Annex
cards.subtitle: Kalmanovitz Hall
cards.notes: Choose the annex for a quieter work break and keep your session flexible around classroom and building activity in Kalmanovitz Hall.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study option connected with Kalmanovitz.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the Kalmanovitz Annex.
cards.access_notes: Kalmanovitz Hall is listed on USF’s campus map; check building access conditions onsite.

cards.title: Malloy Hall Entrance Lounge
cards.subtitle: Malloy Hall
cards.notes: Use the entrance lounge for a short study reset or pre-meeting pause; USF identifies it as a quiet place on campus.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-place lounge at Malloy Hall’s entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the Malloy Hall Entrance Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Malloy Hall is listed on USF’s campus map; check building access conditions onsite.

cards.title: Malloy Hall Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Malloy Hall
cards.notes: Take a reading break or meet a classmate in the courtyard, a named USF quiet-place location associated with Malloy Hall.
cards.short_summary: A courtyard identified by USF as a quiet-place option.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s Quiet Places on Campus guide identifies the Malloy Hall Courtyard.
cards.access_notes: Malloy Hall is listed on USF’s campus map; outdoor comfort and availability depend on conditions.

cards.title: Parina Lounge
cards.subtitle: University Center, third floor
cards.notes: Meet up between classes in this University Center lounge, then use the nearby central-campus services to continue your errand or study session.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor University Center lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: USF lists Parina Lounge on the third floor of the University Center and describes UC as a hub for student life and study space.
cards.access_notes: Located on University Center’s third floor; confirm current building access and lounge availability onsite.

cards.title: Cultural Centers Lounges
cards.subtitle: University Center, fourth floor, Rooms 411–413
cards.notes: Drop in to connect with the Cultural Centers’ student interns, learn about programs, or use the fourth-floor lounges as a community space.
cards.short_summary: Fourth-floor lounges for student community and programming.
cards.evidence_claim: USF says its Cultural Centers lounges in University Center Rooms 411–413 are community and programming spaces where students hang out between classes.
cards.access_notes: USF lists school-year hours: Monday–Thursday 11 a.m.–6 p.m. and Friday 11 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Black Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Gleeson Library, Room 234
cards.notes: Visit the BRC to connect with its programs and clubs, or arrange a peer study session in a space USF describes as communal and supportive.
cards.short_summary: A Gleeson-based community space for Black students and peers.
cards.evidence_claim: USF describes the Black Resource Center as a communal space for hanging out and studying with peers, located in Gleeson Library Room 234.
cards.access_notes: USF lists Monday–Friday hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; its toolkit describes the BRC’s support for Black undergraduate and graduate students.
